page_title: CRY 4-0 MNU | Crystal Palace v Manchester Utd 06/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+5' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Andre Onana has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90+4' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) plays a one-two with Alejandro Garnacho, but the move breaks down.
90+2' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
90+2' Ethan Wheatley (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Good work from Crystal Palace as they win a corner.
88' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
88' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
85' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) replacing Michael Olise.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is replacing Eberechi Eze.
84' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.

82' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is denied by a decent save from Andre Onana.
82' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

81' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ethan Wheatley (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch so that Rasmus Hojlund can be given a rest.
80' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Mason Mount is replaced by Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
80' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' Casemiro (Manchester United) picks out Kobbie Mainoo with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
78' Substitution. Nathaniel Clyne leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace).
77' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
76' Casemiro (Manchester United) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Crystal Palace.
75' The attendance for today's match is 25190.
75' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
73' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:7. The current number of shots on goal is 8:2.
70' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
69' Oliver Glasner is stunned as referee Jarred Gillett shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
69' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
68' Here's the change. Will Hughes leaves the pitch and Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
68' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Mateta is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
66' 4 - 0 Goal! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) neatly controls a decent pass from Daniel Munoz. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the roof of the net from the edge of the box. 4:0.
65' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) tries to find Rasmus Hojlund, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

63' Casemiro (Manchester United) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
63' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

63' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.

62' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
60' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Antony will be replaced by Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United).
60' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' 3 - 0 Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
58' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes a short corner kick.

57' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Andre Onana pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.

57' Andre Onana pulls off a great save to deny Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
56' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is free in the box and Michael Olise finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
53' A goal, which was scored by Casemiro (Manchester United), was disallowed due to offside.

52' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

51' Antony (Manchester United) takes a great touch after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. He immediately steers his shot towards the top left corner. Despite the precise effort, the keeper makes a diving save!
50' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but Andre Onana was alert and made an amazing save!
47' Casemiro (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but Dean Henderson comfortably gathers the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
43' Casemiro (Manchester United) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
42' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd have a free kick.

40' 2 - 0 Goal! Chris Richards slips a clever pass through to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the roof of the net. 2:0.
39' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
36' 4:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

34' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post.
32' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
29' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
28' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) dribbles into the box, but Andre Onana is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
27' Goal disallowed! Casemiro (Manchester United) scores but Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

26' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
25' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Manchester Utd earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

23' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Andre Onana anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
22' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass inside the box and fires the ball goalwards. His attempt is blocked by one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
21' Mason Mount (Manchester United) produces a killer pass onto Rasmus Hojlund, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
18' This shall not pass! Mason Mount (Manchester United) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
16' It could have been a good chance to score! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fails to release Michael Olise with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.

12' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Andre Onana had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
12' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
9' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tries to find Michael Olise with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
6' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
5' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Eberechi Eze was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
2' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
2' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The first half has just begun.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
